# Auris Nexus Technologies

> Auris Nexus Technologies (Pty) Ltd is a technology consulting and digital solutions company based in Sandton, Johannesburg, South Africa. It specialises in custom software development, business automation, AI integration and digital transformation, helping organisations modernise operations, improve efficiency and implement practical technology solutions aligned with their business objectives.

Tagline: Transforming Businesses Through Technology

## Company facts

- Registered name: Auris Nexus Technologies (Pty) Ltd
- Company registration number (CIPC): 2026/606690/07
- Address: 140 Linden Street, Sandown, Sandton, Gauteng 2196, South Africa
- Telephone: 063 122 6552 (+27 63 122 6552)
- Email: info@aurisnexus.co.za
- Website: https://aurisnexus.co.za/
- LinkedIn: https://za.linkedin.com/company/auris-nexus-technologies
- B-BBEE: Level 1 EME
- Primary market: South Africa

## Locations and coverage

- Headquarters and only office: Sandton, Johannesburg, South Africa. There are no offices, staff or registered entities outside South Africa.
- South Africa: works with organisations nationally; outside Gauteng, engagements normally run by video call.
- Outside South Africa: available remotely to organisations elsewhere in Africa and overseas.
- Working hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:00 SAST (UTC+2).
- Details: [Where we work](https://aurisnexus.co.za/where-we-work.html)

## Core services

- [Technology Consulting](https://aurisnexus.co.za/technology-consulting.html): technology strategy, systems assessment, solution architecture and phased technology roadmaps.
- [Custom Software Development](https://aurisnexus.co.za/custom-software-development.html): bespoke business applications, enterprise and multi-tenant platforms, portals, workflow systems and API integrations.
- [Business Automation](https://aurisnexus.co.za/business-automation.html): workflow automation, process digitisation and systems integration.
- [AI Integration](https://aurisnexus.co.za/ai-integration.html): AI assistants, document intelligence and AI inside existing business workflows.
- [Digital Transformation](https://aurisnexus.co.za/digital-transformation.html): business system modernisation, legacy system improvement and digital process transformation.
